meta_description: Architecture and security posture of EEMS Platform — AI-powered emergency response at state scale.

blocks.x: How EEMS Platform is built for 24x7 emergency duty: availability, integrations and the controls that protect patient data.

The platform runs on cloud infrastructure with redundant failover for dispatch continuity. Integrations cover call feeds, hospital availability and vehicle telematics. Sensitive patient data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with access limited by role.
